baslik: The Silent Gas That Kills You in Your Sleep
aciklama:
Carbon monoxide has no smell, no color, and kills people in their sleep. Here is how the silent killer works.

#shorts #science #safety #health #howitworks

sahneler.metin: This gas kills people in their sleep, with no warning.
Carbon monoxide has no color, no smell, and no taste.
It comes from anything that burns fuel - heaters, cars, stoves.
Your blood grabs onto it two hundred times easier than oxygen.
So your body suffocates even in a room full of air.
The first signs feel exactly like being tired or having flu.
People fall asleep and simply never wake up.
A cheap detector is the only thing that can warn you.
You cannot sense it - so the machine has to.
